dedupe_keys.name: energy and industry facilities composite 73 386 power plants and industrial facilities

description: This composite puts power plants and industrial facilities into one table: 73,386 facilities, of which 42,853 are power plants and 30,533 industrial sites, across 211 countries. Fields include facility class, sector (primary fuel for power, subsector for industry), country and ISO3 code, coordinates, capacity and unit, owner, lifecycle status and commissioning year for the power layer, sub-national region, annual generation where reported and annual CO2 where available. The Zenodo page says it is derived from the WRI Global Power Plant Database, Global Energy Monitor and Climate TRACE, and that 35,426 facilities carry CO2, 1,239 regulator-reported (EU ETS, US EPA GHGRP) and 34,189 modelled by Climate TRACE, kept apart by a co2_basis flag. Version 1.1.0 was published on 30 August 2026 by Dmytro Aheiev as a downloadable CSV of about 11 MB with a data dictionary, country summary, datapackage and Croissant metadata and the build script, free under CC BY 4.0, with global coverage. Caveats: the page says the layers are not cross-matched, so the summed CO2 is not a global total, owner coverage is only 15 percent for industry, and industrial capacity keeps each source's own unit. For simulation it is a ready global point layer of power and heavy industry sites for hazard exposure, for linking generation and industrial demand in energy system models and for emissions scenarios. Related catalogue records include the Global Power Plant Database, Climate TRACE and M-FIND.
